newsitem.title: UK: BTR unit Brook Hansen in tie-up with Danfoss.
newsitem.headline: BTR unit Brook Hansen in tie-up with Danfoss.

text.p: Anglo-Australian industrial conglomerate BTR Plc said on Tuesday its unit Brook Hansen had formed an electrical drives alliance with Danfoss Drives Division, a unit of Denmark's Danfoss Group.
BTR said the alliance would help both companies improve product development, product range and market penetration. It gave no financial details in the statement.

A BTR spokesman said the tie-up would link BTR's expertise in gears and transmissions with Danfoss's know-how in inverters, which control the speed of motors. He said the deal was primarily a cooperation agreement.
"This is a deal to exchange technologies although there may be an option to set up something in future," he said.
He declined to give any financial details of the tie-up.
